title: Meridian Trust & Savings Bank - Certificate of Deposit (CD) Ladder Rates Sheet
content:
MERIDIAN TRUST & SAVINGS BANK
CERTIFICATE OF DEPOSIT (CD) & CD LADDER RATE SHEET
Effective Date: November 1, 2026 | Last Updated: November 15, 2026
Headquarters: 100 Meridian Plaza, Charlotte, NC 28202 | Member FDIC | Equal Housing Lender

================================================================================
1. STANDARD & PROMOTIONAL TIME DEPOSIT RATES
================================================================================
Meridian Trust & Savings Bank offers guaranteed fixed-rate Certificates of Deposit (CDs) engineered for predictable yield, capital preservation, and structured laddering strategies. All CDs are FDIC-insured up to $250,000 per depositor.

Current Yield Schedule (Standard CDs - Minimum Deposit $500.00):
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CD Term              Interest Rate    APY*      Minimum Deposit    Early Withdrawal Penalty
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3-Month Standard     3.68%            3.75%     $500.00            90 Days Simple Interest
6-Month Standard     4.40%            4.50%     $500.00            90 Days Simple Interest
9-Month Promotional  4.69%            4.80%     $1,000.00          180 Days Simple Interest
12-Month Standard    4.55%            4.65%     $500.00            180 Days Simple Interest
18-Month Standard    4.31%            4.40%     $500.00            180 Days Simple Interest
24-Month Standard    4.16%            4.25%     $500.00            270 Days Simple Interest
36-Month Standard    4.02%            4.10%     $500.00            360 Days Simple Interest
48-Month Standard    3.88%            3.95%     $500.00            360 Days Simple Interest
60-Month Standard    3.78%            3.85%     $500.00            540 Days Simple Interest
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*APY assumes principal and interest remain on deposit until maturity. Compounded daily, credited monthly.

Jumbo CD Tier Enhancement:
Depositors placing $100,000.00 or greater in any single CD certificate with a maturity term of 12 months or longer receive an automatic bonus margin of +0.15% APY above the published standard rate card.

================================================================================
2. CD LADDER STRATEGIES & SAMPLE ALLOCATIONS
================================================================================
A CD Ladder spreads capital across multiple maturity terms to combine ongoing quarterly or annual liquidity with higher long-term yields. Meridian Trust & Savings Bank offers automated ladder management with zero custodial fees.

Example Model 1: 4-Year Core Consumer Ladder ($100,000 Total Allocation)
- Tranche A: $25,000 in 12-Month CD at 4.65% APY ($1,162.50 annual yield)
- Tranche B: $25,000 in 24-Month CD at 4.25% APY ($1,062.50 annual yield)
- Tranche C: $25,000 in 36-Month CD at 4.10% APY ($1,025.00 annual yield)
- Tranche D: $25,000 in 48-Month CD at 3.95% APY ($987.50 annual yield)
Blended Portfolio APY: 4.2375% | Liquidity: 25% of principal matures every 12 months. Upon maturity, each tranche rolls into a new 48-Month CD, locking peak long-term rates.

Example Model 2: 12-Month Ultra-Short Rolling Ladder ($60,000 Allocation)
- Tranche 1: $15,000 in 3-Month CD at 3.75% APY
- Tranche 2: $15,000 in 6-Month CD at 4.50% APY
- Tranche 3: $15,000 in 9-Month CD at 4.80% APY
- Tranche 4: $15,000 in 12-Month CD at 4.65% APY
Blended Portfolio APY: 4.425% | Liquidity: 25% of portfolio unlocks every 90 days for reinvestment or cash requirements.

================================================================================
3. EARLY WITHDRAWAL PENALTIES & TERMS
================================================================================
Federal regulations and bank policy impose early withdrawal penalties if principal is withdrawn prior to certificate maturity:
1. Terms of 12 Months or Less:
   - Penalty equals 90 days simple interest on the amount withdrawn (180 days for the 9-Month Promotional CD).
2. Terms Greater than 12 Months up to 24 Months:
   - Penalty equals 180 days simple interest on the amount withdrawn (270 days for 24-month terms).
3. Terms Greater than 24 Months up to 60 Months:
   - Penalty equals 360 days simple interest on the amount withdrawn (540 days for 60-month terms).

Penalty Calculation Rules:
- If accrued interest is insufficient to cover the penalty, the remaining penalty amount will be deducted from the principal balance.
- Penalty Exemptions: Penalties are waived in the event of depositor death or legal adjudication of mental incompetence. In addition, qualified distributions from MTSB Traditional or Roth IRA CDs taken after age 59 1/2 are exempt from early withdrawal penalties.

================================================================================
4. MATURITY, RENEWAL & GRACE PERIOD POLICIES
================================================================================
- Maturity Notice: Written and electronic maturity notices are dispatched 30 calendar days prior to CD maturity.
- Grace Period: A 10-calendar-day grace period commences on the calendar day of maturity. During this 10-day window, the depositor may:
  a) Withdraw principal and accrued interest without incurring an early withdrawal penalty;
  b) Deposit additional funds into the certificate;
  c) Change the certificate maturity term to any current standard offering.
- Automatic Renewal: If no instructions are provided prior to the expiration of the 10-day grace period, the CD certificate automatically renews for an identical term at the prevailing market interest rate in effect on the date of maturity. Special promotional CDs (such as the 9-Month promotional CD) automatically roll into the closest standard term (12-Month Standard CD) upon maturity.
- Interest Disbursement Options: Depositors can elect to:
  a) Compound interest back into the CD certificate principal;
  b) Transfer monthly accrued interest automatically to an MTSB checking or savings account;
  c) Disburse monthly or quarterly interest via electronic ACH to an external financial institution.
